_meta.note: Follow-up to the S272 re-verification of every Terminal-Bench-Science value against the announcement SVGs (33/33 matched). Adds the two Pareto charts (total cost, total tokens) — three cost and two token values are stated in prose and the chart geometry reproduces them to ±0.05, which licenses reading the remaining markers the same way — and annotates the three rows whose harness differs from the leaderboard (Anthropic's own re-run of Opus 5 / Fable 5, and Fable 5.1 at max effort). The Mythos 5.1 effort curve on Anthropic's page is Terminal-Bench 4.0, not Terminal-Bench-Science; it is not ingested here. Second part: the TB3.0 launch post (primary source) — 3 leaderboard rows the DB lacked (Grok 4.5 17.8, Sonnet 5 14.6, GLM 5.2 5.1), the 5 S271 rows re-sourced to it, a description for terminal_bench_3, and its cost Pareto chart (7 rows). frontier_bench is retired into terminal_bench_3 (migration s272).

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 — Total Evaluation Cost (USD)
benchmarks.description: Total API cost of one full Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 evaluation (70 tasks × 3 trials) in the leaderboard's own harness, in USD; lower is better. From the announcement's 'Cost vs. Resolution Rate' Pareto chart.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 — Total Tokens (billions)
benchmarks.description: Total tokens consumed by one full Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 evaluation (70 tasks × 3 trials), in billions; lower is better. From the announcement's 'Tokens vs. Resolution Rate' Pareto chart.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 3.0
benchmarks.description: Terminal-Bench 3.0 (Stanford / Harbor / Laude Institute, launched 2026-07-30; v3.0.0 tagged 2026-07-23): 74 community-sourced terminal tasks across 7 domains, built to discriminate frontier from sub-frontier agents (best models ~34% at launch). Pass rate, higher is better. The GitHub repo was previously named 'frontier-bench', so the retired id frontier_bench (S217b, 'Frontier-Bench v0.1') was this benchmark.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 3.0 — Total Evaluation Cost (USD)
benchmarks.description: Total API cost of one full Terminal-Bench 3.0 run (74 tasks) in the Terminal-Bench team's own harness, in USD; lower is better. From the launch post's 'Cost vs Pass Rate' Pareto chart.
